tracked stocks readme.description: Instructions on how to interact with tracked_stocks.json.

tracked stocks.description: The list of all stocks that are being tracked for research, analysis, or trading. Always read tracked stocks readme file first before editing this json file.

stock profiles readme.description: Rules for the per-stock profile folders: file layout, folder naming, which file answers which question, and when each is stale. Read before creating or editing any stock profile file.

stock profiles.description: Directory of cached per-stock research. One folder per stock, named by bare exchange code. Read stock profiles readme first.

stock profile template.description: Template for stock_profile.json - the cover page read first for any stock-specific task.

financial valuation snapshot template.description: Template for financial_valuation_snapshot.json - financial quality, business evidence, and valuation assumptions in one file.

sectors readme.description: Rules for maintaining sectors.md: entry format, controlled vocabularies, update triggers, and bloat control. Read before writing to sectors.md.

sectors.description: Compact sector context board: heat status, current view, drivers, evidence for and against, and watch points. Sector-level only, no stock-specific detail.

source guide.description: Source hierarchy (A/B/C/D) and credibility rules for financial research, including China-market and Kimi search handling.

learned research lessons.description: Agent-curated durable lessons from past research. Weighted by recency and market phase; format documented in the file's own header. Read and write.

user research priorities.description: Human-authored priority topics and standing instructions. Write here only when the user gives an explicit standing instruction.

logs readme.description: To be read first before any files in this folder. Documents log schemas.

daily market notes.description: Daily macro, news, and sector observations. Append-only.

market outcomes.description: Actual market outcomes; may link to predictions. Append-only.

weekly reflections.description: Weekly review summaries of what worked and what failed. Append-only.
